description: ECR repository permits all image tags to be overwritten
rationale: ImageTagMutability=MUTABLE permits overwriting image tags; this can undermine deployment reproducibility. Pull-through cache repositories may intentionally require mutable tags. Exclusion-based policies require individual review and are not automatically considered secure or insecure.
remediation: Where compatible with the image publishing workflow, configure IMMUTABLE image tags or scoped exclusions; validate cache workflows before changing policy.
